title: Baseline Checkpoint
definition: The initial model trained on a specific dataset, serving as a reference point for further improvements or expansions.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A model that has already been trained and serves as a starting point for further improvements or adjustments.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The initial trained model that serves as a reference for evaluating the performance of subsequent models or iterations.
difficulty_levels.expert: The trained model that serves as a benchmark for evaluating the performance of subsequent models or iterations, especially when making improvements or adjustments to the model or its training data.

extra_fields.insight: Using a pre-trained model as a reference to measure the improvements or advancements in subsequent models or iterations.
